$comment: Markup-extraction conformance corpus. A conforming extractor consumes the input (in ANY chunking, including the streaming `chunking` hint) and MUST emit exactly `expected`, in order. Extracted code is whitespace-trimmed. Seeded verbatim from golem-xiv-core/src/test/kotlin/script/GolemScriptExtractionTest.kt (Dialect C: <golem-script purpose="...">...</golem-script>).

cases.name: multiline-script-tag
cases.note: Leading/trailing whitespace around the body is trimmed.

cases.name: multiple-multiline-tags-chunked
cases.source: GolemScriptExtractionTest::should extract multiple multiline script tags from chunked String flow
cases.input:
<golem-script purpose="Set title">
context.title = "Test run"
</golem-script>

Some non-script paragraph.

<golem-script purpose="Calculate numbers">
val result = 2+2
println(result)
result
</golem-script>
cases.note: Non-script prose between blocks is discarded. Extraction is chunking-invariant (here fed as 5-char chunks).

cases.name: no-script-in-plain-text
cases.source: GolemScriptExtractionTest::should not extract script from non-script content

cases.name: incomplete-script-tag-not-extracted
cases.source: GolemScriptExtractionTest::should not extract incomplete script tag
cases.note: A block is emitted only once BOTH the opening `>` and the closing `</golem-script>` are present. Missing end tag => nothing extracted (supports streaming).

cases.name: complex-multiline-body
cases.source: GolemScriptExtractionTest::should extract script with complex content
cases.input:
<golem-script purpose="code">
fun test() {
    return "This is a test"
}
</golem-script>"
cases.note: Trailing characters after the end tag (here a stray `"`) are ignored.

cases.name: empty-purpose
cases.source: GolemScriptExtractionTest::should extract script with empty purpose
cases.note: An empty purpose attribute is valid.
